title: 第553章 最后的反击第552章 臣服免死
lines: “邵老先生，先别急着下定论，至少还有很多人选择跟我们站在一起。”海流沙安慰了一句。
“道门中人追求的无非是力量，刚才那一幕你也看到了，虽然还有很多人没有做出选择，但我相信，他们迟早会做出决定。而且，这么多人选择臣服于他，待会要是动起手来，我们岂不是要杀了自己人？”邵海生摇了摇头，“我们还是太小看那个人了。”
听到这话，海流沙沉吟了一会，正准备劝他不要轻易放弃。但这时，她的目光好像看到了什么，美眸不由一亮，“邵老先生，你看那里。”
顺着她手指的方向望去，只见一具残破的棺椁摆放在空地上。邵海生微微一愣，立刻反应过来，“你想用那个东西对付他？”
“不错！”海流沙点了点头，“那具棺椁的材质对他有克制作用，只是，我们之前交手的时候，使用的材料太少，所以作用并不明显。如果我们能利用它，说不定还有反败为胜的机会。”
邵海生想了想，微微颔首道：“现在也没有别的办法了，只要有一线希望，我们都不能放弃。海掌门，我们会想办法拖住他，给你制造机会，至于能不能成功，就看你的了。”说完，他足尖一点，身形拔地而起，悬立在半空中。
看到他的举动，众人不由觉得奇怪。袁弘皱了皱眉，开口道：“你这是要干什么？”

对于他的话，邵海生恍若未闻，自顾自的说道：“各位同道，难道你们都忘了之前那些人是怎么死的吗？我相信，在那些人当中，肯定有你们认识的人，或者是至亲好友。可现在呢，你们却选择臣服一个杀人凶手，要是让那些死去的人知道，他们会怎么看待你们？道门兴衰从来不是一个人的事情，而是千千万万的道门中人一起撑起来的。今天，你们不是为道门而战，而是为了你们自己的未来而战。我恳请大家放下一切成见和仇怨，联手抗敌，不要被一时的诱惑蒙蔽了眼睛。”
话音落下，他身形一动，口中大喝一声，径直朝着那名男子冲了过去。
“师父，我来助你。”霍水榛尾随其后，全身气势暴涨，目光坚定无比。与此同时，尚霓裳，卿曼容，还有裘燕南等人纷纷催动身形，加入到了战局中。
“哼！真是一群不知死活的家伙。”袁弘微眯着眼，看着出手的众人，不由冷笑了一声。对方能让季杭从神境中期轻松突破到巅峰境界，足见他的恐怖。就算有再多的神境强者，估计也不是对手，更何况是这几个人。正想着，他的耳边突然传来一个熟悉的声音：“各位，能跟大家共事多年，是我的荣幸，但到了这个地步，大家都自求多福吧。”
此话一出，袁弘的脸色猛地一变，转头看向一旁的傅余庵，沉声道：“你这话什么意思，难道你要背叛我？”
“袁先生，多谢你这些年的照顾，目前的情势你比谁都清楚，要么臣服，要么死。正如邵老先生所言，现在，我们不再是为了各自的势力而战，而是为了我们自己。只有齐心协力，才有一线希望。袁先生，我希望你明白，到了这种时候，别再抱有侥幸心理了。”话音落下，傅余庵不再多言，身形一跃而起，加入到了邵海生的阵营中。
看着迅速逼近的道门中人，男子身姿傲立，背负着双手，满脸轻蔑之色，“一群不自量力的蝼蚁，来人，给我杀了他们！”然而，选择臣服的众人在得到他的命令后，却并没有出手的意思，而是面面相视，似乎还有些犹豫。
就在刚才，这些人还跟他们是同一阵营的，现在让他们痛下杀手，无论是谁，内心多多少少会有些抗拒。见他们迟迟不肯动手，男子微皱着眉头，缓缓道：“你们不是想拥有永生和强大的力量吗？替我杀了他们，证明你们的忠心，我会一一满足你们的愿望。”
听到这话，原本还犹豫不决的众人立刻做出了抉择。正所谓人不为己天诛地灭，相比别人的性命，自身的利益才是最重要的。一时间，上百人齐齐出手，将邵海生一行人给拦截了下来。
此刻，海流沙独自一人朝着那具残破的棺椁冲去，到了半路上，她眼角余光一扫，身形陡地一顿。接着，她足尖轻点，宛如一阵清风拂过，几个起落间，人已经到了沈逸飞的旁边。
看到躺在地上，浑身鲜血淋漓的沈逸飞，海流沙的美眸中闪过一丝不忍之色，当时要不是为了给他们争取逃脱的时间，沈逸飞也不至于落得这样的下场。她快步走上前，将半昏迷状态的沈逸飞搀扶了起来，然后把一道灵力注入到对方的体内。顿时，只听沈逸飞发出一阵细微的呻吟声，半眯的眼睛慢慢睁了开来。
“海掌门……”他蠕动着嘴唇，有气无力的说道：“想不到还能再见到你。”
“沈先生，你怎么样，没事吧？”
“死不了，只是成了废人而已。”沈逸飞很吃力的问道：“他呢？”
海流沙知道他问的是谁，当下用手指了指远处那名凌空而立的男子。看到邵海生一行人被道门中人阻截住，即使海流沙不说，他也猜到了原因。“你们不能让他得逞，我跟他交手的时候，他已经耗费了不少气力，眼下，他的实力还没恢复到巅峰，加上刚才力量损耗过大，只要你们联手，说不定有机会击败他。记住，这是唯一的机会，你们一定要把握住。”
“原来如此！”海流沙顿时恍然。难怪对方会引诱道门中人臣服于他，这么做无非是想保留实力，给自己争取足够的时间恢复力量。
“快去吧，做你该做的事情，不用管我。”
“我知道了。”海流沙点了点头，将沈逸飞搀扶到一旁落座，然后径直往那具棺椁所在的位置赶去。
“都给我让开！”半空中，邵海生怒声喝道：“念在同道中人的份上，我不想伤你们的性命，别逼我下杀手。”
content_en:
"Mr. Shao, don't rush to a conclusion yet, at least there are still many people who choose to stand with us." Hai Liusha comforted.
"What people in the Taoist sect pursue is nothing more than power. You saw the scene just now. Although there are still many people who have not made a choice, I believe that they will make a decision sooner or later. Moreover, so many people choose to surrender to him. If we take action later, wouldn't we have to kill our own people?" Shao Haisheng shook his head, "We still underestimate that person too much."
Hearing this, Hai Liusha pondered for a while and was about to persuade him not to give up easily. But at this time, her eyes seemed to see something, and her beautiful eyes couldn't help but light up, "Mr. Shao, look over there."
Looking in the direction of her finger, she saw a broken coffin placed in the open space. Shao Haisheng was stunned for a moment, then immediately reacted, "You want to use that thing against him?"
"Yes!" Hai Liusha nodded, "The material of the coffin has a restraining effect on him. However, when we fought before, we used too little material, so the effect was not obvious. If we can use it, we might have a chance to turn defeat into victory."
邵海生想了想，微微颔首道：“现在也没有别的办法了，只要有一线希望，我们都不能放弃。海掌门，我们会想办法拖住他，给你制造机会，至于能不能成功，就看你的了。”说完，他足尖一点，身形拔地而起，悬立在半空中。
Seeing his behavior, everyone couldn't help but feel strange. Yuan Hong frowned and said, "What are you going to do?"
Regarding his words, Shao Haisheng seemed to have not heard anything and said to himself: "Comrades, have you forgotten how those people died before? I believe that among those people, there must be people you know, or close relatives and friends. But now, you have chosen to surrender to a murderer. If those who died know , what will they think of you? The rise and fall of the Taoist sect is never a matter of one person, but is supported by thousands of Taoist sects. Today, you are not fighting for the Taoist sect, but for your own future. I implore everyone to put aside all prejudices and hatreds, join forces to fight against the enemy, and do not be blinded by temporary temptations."
As soon as he finished speaking, he moved, shouted loudly, and rushed towards the man.
"Master, I'm here to help you." Huo Shuizhen followed, her aura surged and her eyes were firm. At the same time, Shang Nishang, Qing Manrong, Qiu Yannan and others all mobilized and joined the battle.
"Huh! What a bunch of guys who don't know how to live or die." Yuan Hong squinted his eyes slightly, looked at the people who took action, and couldn't help but sneered. The opponent was able to easily break through Ji Hang from the middle stage of the divine realm to the peak realm, which shows how terrifying he is.就算有再多的神境强者，估计也不是对手，更何况是这几个人。 Just as he was thinking about it, a familiar voice suddenly came to his ears: "Everyone, it is my honor to work with you for many years, but at this point, everyone should just ask for their own blessings."
As soon as these words came out, Yuan Hong's expression suddenly changed, he turned to look at Fu Yu'an aside, and said in a deep voice: "What do you mean by this? Do you want to betray me?"
"Mr. Yuan, thank you for your care over the years. You know the current situation better than anyone else. Either surrender or die. As Mr. Shao said, now we are no longer fighting for our respective forces, but for ourselves. Only Only with concerted efforts can there be a glimmer of hope. Mr. Yuan, I hope you understand that at this time, don't take chances anymore." After the words fell, Fu Yu'an stopped talking and jumped up to join Shao Haisheng's camp.
Looking at the people from the Taoist sect who were approaching quickly, the man stood proudly, with his hands behind his back, and a look of contempt on his face, "A bunch of overestimating ants, come here, kill them!" However, after receiving his order, the people who chose to surrender had no intention of taking action, but looked at each other, seemingly hesitant.
Just a moment ago, these people were in the same camp as them. Now if they are asked to kill, no matter who they are, they will have some resistance in their hearts. Seeing that they were reluctant to take action, the man frowned slightly and said slowly: "Don't you want to have eternal life and powerful power? Kill them for me to prove your loyalty, and I will fulfill your wishes one by one."
After hearing this, everyone who was originally hesitant immediately made a decision. As the saying goes, if you don't take care of yourself, you will be punished by heaven and earth. Compared with the lives of others, your own interests are the most important. In an instant, hundreds of people took action and intercepted Shao Haisheng and his party.
At this moment, Hai Liusha was rushing towards the broken coffin alone. Halfway through, she glanced out of the corner of her eye and her body suddenly stopped. Then, she tapped her toes, like a breeze blowing by, and within a few ups and downs, she was already next to Shen Yifei.
Seeing Shen Yifei lying on the ground with blood all over his body, Hai Liusha's beautiful eyes flashed with a hint of unbearability. If he hadn't been trying to buy them time to escape, Shen Yifei wouldn't have ended up like this. She walked forward quickly, helped the semi-conscious Shen Yifei up, and then injected a spiritual power into his body. Suddenly, Shen Yifei was heard moaning slightly, and his half-lidded eyes slowly opened.
"Master Hai..." He wriggled his lips and said feebly, "I never thought I would see you again."
"Mr. Shen, how are you, are you okay?"
"He can't die, he just became a useless person." Shen Yifei asked with great difficulty: "Where is he?"
Hai Liusha knew who he was asking, and pointed at the man standing in the distance. Seeing Shao Haisheng and his party being intercepted by people from the Taoist sect, he could guess the reason even if Hai Liusha didn't tell them. "You can't let him succeed. When I fought with him, he had already spent a lot of energy. At the moment, his strength has not yet returned to its peak. In addition, the strength loss was too large just now. As long as you join forces, you may have a chance to defeat him. Remember, this is the only chance, you must seize it."
"That's it!" Hai Liusha suddenly realized. No wonder the other party would seduce people from the Taoist sect to surrender to him. This was simply to preserve his strength and buy himself enough time to recover his strength.
"Go on, do what you have to do, and leave me alone."
"I understand." Hai Liusha nodded, helped Shen Yifei to the side and sat down, and then rushed straight to the location of the coffin.
"Get out of my way!" Shao Haisheng shouted angrily in mid-air: "For the sake of my comrades, I don't want to hurt your lives, so don't force me to kill you."
title_en: Chapter 553 The final counterattack Chapter 552 Surrender and avoid death
